function stickyGeometryCase(v) {
 document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';document.documentElement.style.cssText='';
 const c={},top=20+(v%16),padding=v%4,border=1+(v%3),shift=v%7;
 const host=document.createElement('div'),contents=document.createElement('div'),pre=document.createElement('div'),container=document.createElement('div'),filler=document.createElement('div'),sticky=document.createElement('div'),child=document.createElement('div');
 host.style.cssText='position:relative;top:'+shift+'px;width:120px;height:200px;padding:'+padding+'px;border:'+border+'px solid;overflow:hidden';
 contents.style.cssText='width:100%;height:500px';pre.style.cssText='width:100%;height:100px';container.style.cssText='width:100%;height:300px';filler.style.cssText='width:100%;height:100px';sticky.style.cssText='position:sticky;top:'+top+'px;width:100%;height:100px';child.style.cssText='position:sticky;top:'+(top+15)+'px;width:20px;height:40px';
 host.append(contents);contents.append(pre,container);container.append(filler,sticky);sticky.append(child);document.body.append(host);
 c.offsetParent=sticky.offsetParent===host&&container.offsetParent===host&&child.offsetParent===sticky;
 c.client=host.clientWidth===120+2*padding&&host.clientHeight===200+2*padding&&host.clientTop===border&&host.clientLeft===border;
 c.offsetSize=host.offsetWidth===120+2*(padding+border)&&host.offsetHeight===200+2*(padding+border);
 c.scrollSize=host.scrollHeight===500+2*padding&&host.scrollWidth===120+2*padding;
 c.normal=sticky.offsetTop===200+padding&&sticky.getBoundingClientRect().y===shift+border+padding+200;
 host.scrollTop=100;c.before=sticky.offsetTop===200+padding&&sticky.getBoundingClientRect().y===shift+border+padding+100;
 host.scrollTop=200;c.stuck=sticky.offsetTop===200+top+padding&&sticky.getBoundingClientRect().y===shift+border+padding+top;
 c.nested=child.offsetParent===sticky&&child.offsetTop===15&&child.getBoundingClientRect().y===sticky.getBoundingClientRect().y+15;
 host.scrollTop=300;c.boundary=sticky.offsetTop===300+padding&&sticky.getBoundingClientRect().y===shift+border+padding;
 host.scrollTop=1e9;c.clampEnd=host.scrollTop===300;
 host.scrollTop=-50;c.clampStart=host.scrollTop===0;
 host.scrollTop=123.5;c.pixelRounding=host.scrollTop===124;
 host.scrollTop=NaN;c.nan=host.scrollTop===0;
 host.scrollTop=Infinity;c.infinity=host.scrollTop===0;
 host.scrollTop={valueOf(){return 150}};c.coercion=host.scrollTop===150;
 const fail=f=>{try{f();return false}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError}};
 c.bigint=fail(()=>{host.scrollTop=1n});c.symbol=fail(()=>{host.scrollTop=Symbol()});c.objectBigint=fail(()=>{host.scrollTop={valueOf(){return 1n}}});
 c.brand=fail(()=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Element.prototype,'scrollTop').get.call({}))&&fail(()=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLElement.prototype,'offsetTop').get.call({}));
 c.readonly=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLElement.prototype,'offsetTop').set===undefined;
 host.scrollLeft=100;c.noHorizontal=host.scrollLeft===0;
 host.style.overflow='clip';host.scrollTop=100;c.clip=host.scrollTop===0;host.style.overflow='hidden';host.scrollTop=200;
 sticky.style.position='static';c.static=sticky.offsetTop===200+padding;sticky.style.position='sticky';c.restored=sticky.offsetTop===200+top+padding;
 sticky.style.top='10%';c.percentTop=sticky.offsetTop===220+padding;sticky.style.top=top+'px';
 host.style.display='none';c.hidden=sticky.offsetWidth===0&&sticky.offsetTop===0&&sticky.offsetParent===null;host.style.display='block';
 host.remove();c.detached=sticky.offsetWidth===0&&sticky.offsetTop===0&&sticky.offsetParent===null;
 document.body.append(host);host.scrollTop=200;c.reattached=sticky.offsetTop===200+top+padding;
 return c;
}
